scope: Proposition 9 (The 25-move strategy) of the manuscript “Snaky in 21 Maker moves” (preprints/Snaky-in-21-Maker-moves-September-25-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 187 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e5ce107fdc4ec77f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is one ordinary Maker policy on the infinite square board that, from the empty position, completes a copy of S within 25 actual fresh Maker claims against every legal Breaker continuation. In the fixed-endpoint formulation, after extending the policy by fresh moves beyond an earlier win, the Maker set after its 25th claim contains a target whenever the first 24 Breaker replies are legal along the policy.
